semiconductor_relevance: High — Lync Semi LLC specializes in legacy semiconductor equipment and parts, providing critical support to fabs and OEMs.
summary: Lync Semi LLC focuses on the legacy semiconductor equipment market, offering services such as buying, selling, and investing in used tools and components, particularly from Applied Materials. The company provides consignment services, advisory services, compliance support, and on-site installation, repair, and upgrades, ensuring the extended life and value of critical systems.
capabilities: On-site installation and repair for legacy systems
Global distribution of used semiconductor equipment
